title: Binance Futures Updates Trading Fee Discount for TradFi Perps (2026-03-31)
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures updates the trading fee discount promotion for  all TradFi perpetual contracts (TradFi Perps) .  All Binance regular to VIP 9 users will  enjoy 0 maker fees  when trading any TradFi Perps during the Promotion Period. In addition, regular to VIP 3 users will receive a  20% discount on taker fees  and VIP 4 to 9 users will receive a  50% discount on taker fees , compared to the standard USDT taker fee rate. Promotion Period:  2026-03-31 02:00 (UTC) until further notice Promotional Trading Fee Structure for TradFi Perps:  VIP Level Maker Fee Taker Fee Taker Fee ( With 10% Discount When Paying With BNB ) Regular User 0.0000% 0.0400% 0.0360% VIP 1 0.0000% 0.0400% 0.0360% VIP 2 0.0000% 0.0320% 0.0288% VIP 3 0.0000% 0.0256% 0.0230% VIP 4 0.0000% 0.0150% 0.0135% VIP 5 0.0000% 0.0135% 0.0122% VIP 6 0.0000% 0.0125% 0.0113% VIP 7 0.0000% 0.0110% 0.0099% VIP 8 0.0000% 0.0100% 0.0090% VIP 9 0.0000% 0.0085% 0.0077% Please Note: The implementation of the new trading fee discount structure is scheduled for  2026-03-31 02:00 (UTC) . During this period, users may experience temporary discrepancies in fee calculations.  Qualified Market Makers in the  USDⓈ-M Futures Liquidity Provider Program  will follow their weekly maker rebate tiers as usual for TradFi Perps. The taker discount in the  USDⓢ-M Futures Taker Program  will also apply to TradFi Perps.
